title: Look, Reason, Draw a Region: Recursive Refinement for Spatial Context Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.23302v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spatial context prediction requires visual grounding and spatial reasoning to identify vacant regions relative to objects in a scene. Spatial relationships and physical constraints remain challenging for large vision-language models (VLMs). Recursive reasoning has demonstrated strong performance on discrete and abstract reasoning tasks, motivating its use for improving spatial context prediction in natural images. Weight sharing enables higher accuracy with a small trainable parameter count. We introduce Spatial-TRM, a compact recursive model with frozen vision-language features, a convex region decoder, and just 11.2M trainable parameters. This weight-tied reasoner supports six spatial relationships, three reference frames, and open-vocabulary anchor objects. translated_title: 观察、推理、绘制区域：面向空间上下文预测的递归细化方法
translated_abstract: 空间上下文预测需要视觉定位和空间推理能力，以识别场景中相对于物体可用的空闲区域。空间关系和物理约束对于大型视觉-语言模型（VLM）而言仍然充满挑战。递归推理已在离散和抽象推理任务上展现出强大的性能，这启发我们将其应用于改进自然图像中的空间上下文预测。权重共享使模型能够以少量可训练参数实现更高精度。我们提出了Spatial-TRM，一个紧凑的递归模型，它采用冻结的视觉-语言特征、凸区域解码器，且仅有1120万可训练参数。这个权重共享的推理器支持六种空间关系、三种参考坐标系以及开放词汇的锚定物体。在RoboSpatial-Home基准测试中，Spatial-TRM实现了29.51%的上下文准确率，相比单独训练的单步模型提升了9.02个百分点（相对提升44.0%）。
tldr: Spatial-TRM是一个仅有1120万可训练参数的紧凑递归推理模型，通过冻结视觉-语言特征与递归细化机制，在RoboSpatial-Home基准上将空间上下文预测准确率大幅提升9.02个百分点。
en_tdlr: Spatial-TRM is a compact recursive reasoning model with only 11.2M trainable parameters that leverages frozen vision-language features and recursive refinement to boost spatial context prediction accuracy by 9.02 percentage points on the RoboSpatial-Home benchmark.
